title_en: The Pros and Cons of AI
note_en: 越 … 越 … means "the more … the more …": 技术进步的速度越快，社会就越需要相应的法律 "the faster technology advances, the more society needs matching laws." Unlike English, which fronts "the more," Chinese puts 越 right before each adjective or verb, usually with 就 in the second half. A related pattern is 越来越 "more and more": 虚假信息越来越多 "more and more false information."
